Web · /board-sizes · Wisconsin Creative

One board at a time

Click any board's name to open it on its own: a larger drawing that stays pinned while you scroll its zones, layouts you can switch between, filters, and arrow keys to move to the next board.

After only

This is a new view, so there's no before. Chromium at 1440 × 1000 and 390 × 844, light mode, manifest 2026-10-08.2.

What changed, and why

One-board view

Was

Every board was a card in a long venue page.

Now

?d=<display id> opens a single board, from its card title, from search, or by link. ← and → step through every board.

Layouts (draft)

Was

North Board's 26 zones were all drawn at once.

Now

Manifest 2026-10-08.2 adds named layouts to the North Board, Kellner and Club Board, inferred from geometry and marked draft. The build script rejects a layout zone that doesn't exist or that overlaps another.

Filters

Was

Nothing.

Now

Video, Stills only and Open issues chips with counts. A filter only appears when it would narrow the list. Filtered-out zones dim in the drawing and leave the list.

History and search

Was

Back left the page, and searching for an id or canvas key found nothing.

Now

Each view change is a history entry. Search matches ids and keys; Enter on an exact one opens the board and flashes the zone.

Verification

  • tests/static-tools.test.ts: 47 passed (new: layout zones must exist and must not overlap)
  • node scripts/build-board-sizes.mjs: manifest 2026-10-08.2 valid; data.js, index.json and llms.txt regenerated; boards.csv unchanged
  • npm run verify:docs (exit 0) and git diff --check: pass
  • Playwright: card title opens ?d=camp-randall/kellner; → opens South Upper Fascia; Back twice returns to Kellner, then Camp Randall; MAIN_VIDEO finds 1 row and Enter opens the North Board at main-video-fg; Enter on kohl-center/360-fascia opens it; no page errors
  • Playwright: after scrolling the list, clicking Main Video in the pinned drawing lands its row below the drawing (1440: row top 337 vs drawing bottom 329; 390: 237 vs 229). ← / → with focus on a chip keeps the board
  • Browser pane (dark mode): Kellner with the Main + ads layout renders, no console errors

Things to know

  • Layouts are a guess from geometry until someone who runs the boards confirms them. To confirm, drop draft: true from each layout in boards.json and bump the version.
  • Kohl Center and Field House still have no zone positions. The Board Info sheet's OLD tabs have positions for the retired KC-Ring-P / KC-Fascia-P layout, but zone names, sizes and processors differ from today's (e.g. ring sponsor 1046 vs 1056 wide), so nothing was imported. A Display Studio zone export, or screenshots of each processor's zone X/Y, would fill them in.
